text:
ana: Quick sync on playground structured output & tool-calling UX. Uploaded small prototype to staging. Need fast takes on schema editor, function/tool defs, and run history.

tom: Saw it. Prefer persistent left rail for defs over modal when iterating rapidly. Modal ok for one-off edits.

kevin: left rail but collapsible sections please. current rail steals editor width on small screens.

mira: accessibility: collapsibles need aria-expanded, focus trapping avoided, and a keyboard shortcut to jump to schema (Ctrl+Shift+S).

tom: schema validation copy: change "Validate Schema" -> "Check schema (quick)". Add inline lint (yellow on blur) + explicit full validation button.

ana: function defs: guided form (name, args, types, desc) + code mirror below. Allow paste of signatures like `getWeather(location: string) -> {temp:number}` and offer parsed JSON schema suggestion.

kevin: run history: vertical list > horizontal. Each entry: small header (time, model, deployment), collapsed args/outputs tree, and a diff button for replays. Virtualize long lists.

mira: JSON tree must support keyboard expand/collapse and a "linear view" for screen readers. Announce generation results via live region.

tom: add a dry-run toggle (no billing) with clear locked state for Dedicated/Private. show lock icon + explanation.

ana: microcopy: call button label -> "Invoke tool / function" and tooltip: "Runs the selected tool with current args and records the run."

kevin: perf note: only hydrate payloads on expand and memoize parsed trees. add "Copy JSON" and "Download" CTAs prominently.

mira: color badges for provenance (hosted/dedicated/private) ok but include icons for colorblind users. maintain contrast ratio.

tom: action items: tom mock left-rail collapsibles, ana wire up signature parsing examples, kevin spike virtualized history, mira compile accessibility checklist. ETA EoW for spikes.

ui-bot: deploy: playground-proto-18 -> staging at 2024-04-09T11:22:10Z :rocket:

ana: thanks all, i'll collect these into a short spec and post it in #product later.
